list: 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. All offline, single-player; no online trophies.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Plan around the long tail: the story takes roughly 60–80 hours and the full 100% completion grind pushes the total to about 200 hours, so treat this as the final reward for finishing everything else in this guide. Keep cheats off for the whole run — using any cheat disables trophies and saving while it is active. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing and this unlocks automatically. It is the first story trophy and cannot be missed — just play through the intro. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete every mission in Chapter 1. Before you leave the chapter, do the balcony meditation with Lucia — after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning and accept her invitation to meditate. That first meditation is the only interaction currently flagged as potentially missable (see Positive Mental Attitude). Keep a manual save at the end of each chapter; there is no mission replay. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete every mission in Chapter 2. Story trophies unlock automatically as the chapters end, so there is no side requirement — just finish the chapter's missions in order. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete every mission in Chapter 3. As with the other chapter trophies it unlocks on its own when the chapter closes, with no extra objective. Use the chapter to keep scanning new vehicles with the WAiNK app and studying animals with binoculars — that progress counts toward the 100% checklist later. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete every mission in Chapter 4. The eight large bank vault robberies unlock during this chapter through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — do them when they open, since they feed both the 100% checklist and Maximum Withdrawal. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission and this gold unlocks. The story runs five chapters and about 60–80 hours; no gold medals are needed in story missions. After the credits you can keep exploring Leonida freely, so the cleanup phase starts from here. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies unlock when the mission ends; none of them can be missed, and there is no mission replay, so keep manual saves (15 slots) at the start and end of each chapter as a safety net. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks automatically when the mission is done. Heist-style missions also teach the robbery systems you will reuse for the bank vault, armored truck and gang operation trophies later. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like every mission trophy it pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It unlocks automatically at the end of the mission. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. It pops when the mission ends. The airport is also where Catch Me If You Can happens later — stealing a departing passenger aircraft — so learn the layout while you are here. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story and work down the in-game checklist — your earlier progress already counts. The checklist is lenient: it asks for portions, not everything (for example 39 of 39 gang operations and 22 of 22 bank jobs, but only 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos, 15 of 18 card sets, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts and 42 of 42 Shooting Range gold medals). Both KeenGamer and PowerPyx rank this the hardest trophy; expect around 100 hours of cleanup after the story. Do not chase every collectible: the checklist only wants portions of most activities, so stop each one the moment its target is met, and leave the 10 hardest challenges unfinished. Finish optional tasks early — there are more than the 100 required, so missing a few does not block you. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/) and PowerPyx.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Perform 250 unique stunts across Leonida — jumps, near-misses, airtime and the other stunt categories the game tracks. The 100% checklist wants 300 of 397 stunts, so keep doing them past this trophy: use fast bikes and cars on ramps and jumps you find while exploring, and check Progress > Stats to see which stunt types you still need. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once — races, shooting range, fishing, arcade games, pool, mini golf, basketball, bowling and drone races are the activities the guides list. Just start one of each; winning is not required. Do this early, while the activities are being introduced, so you learn which ones you enjoy before the 100% grind. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are no difficulty-related trophies, so take your time: learn each range's target pattern, use the weapon the challenge expects, and replay a challenge as often as needed — gold medals are also required 42 of 42 for the 100% checklist, so this is not skippable. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations, and complete all 42 Drone Time Trials for the 100% checklist. Learn each course's line before racing it — the time trials teach you the routes, so run those first and the race wins follow. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The 100% checklist wants 30 of 40 unique races won, so keep racing past this trophy. Pick the fastest vehicle class you are comfortable with, learn the shortcuts on each course, and use race challenge gold medals (10 of 13 needed for 100%) as practice. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing contest and out-fish him. Fishing is introduced in the opening mission Gone Fishing; match the bait and spot to the fish the challenge asks for, keep your line tension steady, and reel in smoothly rather than yanking. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any arcade game through to its end. The 100% checklist wants all 4 video games played, so try each cabinet while you are there — the easiest completion counts for this trophy. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to his final mission. Character questlines unlock as you meet the characters in the world; do their missions when they appear rather than leaving them all for the end, since some optional missions become unavailable during certain story sections. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to his final mission. Kenton is tied to the treasure sets — the 100% checklist wants 5 of 7 of Kenton's Treasure Sets — so hunt treasures while you work his strand. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to his final mission. Like the other character finales, it unlocks by playing his strand when it appears; do it before the final cleanup pass so nothing is left hanging. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight qualifying Strangers & Freaks mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as markers in the world — talk to them, follow their strands to the end, and keep a manual save before starting one in case a strand branches. There are more strands than the eight required, so you can skip one that gives you trouble. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to his final mission. Do the character strands as they unlock during the story rather than saving them all for after the credits. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to his final mission. Together with Andy, Kenton, Billy and Randy, Tyrone's finale is one of the five character questlines to clear before the platinum. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida (10 locations, with Jason and Lucia). POTENTIALLY MISSABLE — the only trophy the guides flag: after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning; when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept her invitation. Do that first meditation before leaving Chapter 1. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations, but this trophy needs all 18, so finish the remaining spots during cleanup. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter — there is no mission replay, and you have 15 manual save slots to rotate through. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/) and PowerPyx.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret as part of his Target Deck. The 100% checklist wants all 15 of Bret's Target Deck hunting objectives, so work his deck while you hunt: track the target animal, use the right weapon and approach quietly. Studying animals with binoculars (100 of 255 species for 100%) also helps you learn where the rare ones live. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; the 100% checklist wants 15 of 18 sets, so you will keep collecting long after this trophy. Check your collection in the Progress menu, and pick up cards whenever you pass a known spot rather than doing them all in one sweep. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations. Scan everything unfamiliar from the start — vehicles, landmarks and locations — because the 100% checklist also wants 200 base-model vehicles scanned and the two goals overlap heavily. Open the WAiNK app whenever the prompt appears and make scanning a habit on every trip. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so aim past this trophy and leave the 10 hardest challenges for last — KeenGamer's advice is to finish 70 and skip the most time-consuming ones. Challenges cover combat, driving, exploration and activities, so most complete naturally as you play. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it in open countryside with a fast car ready: break line of sight, hide until the search cone shrinks, and switch vehicles if the heat stays on you. Your partner must be with you when the stars clear. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without letting your Wanted level clear between them. Plan a route of three close shops, keep a fast getaway car parked outside each one, and move quickly — the chain breaks if the wanted level drops to zero. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, so scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app as you find it and drive anything unfamiliar at least once. Vehicles cluster by area — city streets, the docks, the countryside and the airport each hide different models. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one activation of Combat Focus. Pick a fight with a group — a gang hangout or a wanted-level shootout — activate Combat Focus when several enemies are in view, and chain the kills before the meter runs out. A high-capacity weapon helps. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport and take off with it. Wait on the tarmac for a plane taxiing to the runway, board it quickly, and get airborne before airport security stops you — a fast approach vehicle and a clear runway help. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Rhinos appear at military sites — go in with a plan, grab the tank, and fire the cannon at enemies or vehicles to register combat use. Expect heavy resistance on the way in and out. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without triggering detection. Go at a quiet hour, avoid the cameras and the guard's sightline, smash the cases quickly and leave before the alarm draws police. If you are spotted, leave and try again — a clean run is what counts. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. The eight large vaults unlock during Chapter 4 through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is…; the 100% checklist wants all 8, so this trophy comes naturally on the way there. Plan an escape route before you crack a vault, and bring a fast car. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Block the truck's path, force the crew out or breach the rear doors, grab the cash, and lose the wanted level before the trophy pops. Trucks run set routes around the city — wait at a quiet stretch of road rather than chasing one through traffic. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida and uncover the complete map. Drive, fly and sail into every corner — the map fills in as you visit each area, including the islands, the swamps and the far countryside. Pair this with vehicle discovery and WAiNK scans so the same trips count three times. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 gang operations, so this trophy comes early in that grind — just make sure your robberies cover every gang rather than farming one. Check the Progress menu to see which gangs you still owe. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: BELUM TERKONFIRMASI — the exact trigger is still being confirmed by the guide sites. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach: go to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach and order a cocktail. If it does not pop, try a different bar or time of day and watch for updated confirmations. Do not rely on an unverified method. Sources: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/); PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: BELUM TERKONFIRMASI — the exact method is still unconfirmed. The description points to smashing a vehicle out through a showroom's front: drive a car into a showroom and out through the glass, in the style of the classic scene. If it does not pop, the trigger may need a specific showroom or vehicle — check the guides again after launch-era confirmations. Sources: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/); PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, steal the three key valuables and escape. Case the alley first, grab the three items in one visit, and leave before security locks the place down. Bowling itself counts toward the activity checklist (mini golf and pool have their own 100% targets), so play a frame while you are there. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Build Strength through the activities that raise it — workouts, melee and heavy lifting — and keep at it for both characters; the stat grows with repeated effort, so fold it into your daily routine rather than grinding it in one sitting. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. The profile tracks your criminal activity across the game, so this builds up naturally as you rob, race, fight and explore — just play the game the way the other trophies ask and check the counter in the Progress menu now and then. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: BELUM TERKONFIRMASI — no guide has pinned down the unlock method yet. The description ("Second time's the charm") suggests retrying something that failed the first time, but no source confirms what. trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; fence them through contacts rather than spending them dirty. This also counts toward the 100% checklist (Marked Bills Fenced $250,000), so it comes naturally if you fence everything you steal. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops. Buy weapons, clothes, car upgrades and properties as you play — the counter is cumulative across every shop, and the robbery money gives you plenty to spend. Check the Progress menu to see how close you are. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all eight purchasable garage properties. Garages cost robbery money — fence narcotics, jewelry, marked bills and vehicles (the checklist wants $100,000 narcotics, $100,000 jewelry, $250,000 marked bills and $200,000 vehicles fenced) and buy garages as they appear on the map. Source: KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/).
